questions.subject: hass
questions.prompt:
A timeline shows events in a country town.
1950: Post office opened
1962: Library opened
1975: Swimming pool opened
1988: Skate park opened
Which building opened second?
questions.explanation: A timeline goes in order from earliest to latest. The library is the second date, 1962.

questions.subject: hass
questions.prompt:
Kim's family timeline says:
2018: Moved to Darwin
2021: Baby sister Lily was born
2025: Kim started Year 3
How many years after moving to Darwin was Lily born?
questions.explanation: Count from 2018 to 2021. That is 3 years.

questions.subject: hass
questions.prompt: On a map, north is at the top. The school is north of the oval. The shop is east of the oval. Which way do you go from the shop to the school?
questions.explanation: The school is north of the oval and the shop is east of it. So from the shop you go north and west.

questions.subject: hass
questions.prompt:
A weather table for Alice Springs shows the top temperature each day.
Monday: 34 degrees
Tuesday: 38 degrees
Wednesday: 31 degrees
Thursday: 36 degrees
Which day was the hottest?
questions.explanation: 38 is the biggest number in the table. It is for Tuesday.

questions.subject: hass
questions.prompt: A map scale says 1 cm on the map is 2 km in real life. Two towns are 5 cm apart on the map. How many kilometres apart are the towns in real life?
questions.explanation: Each centimetre is 2 km. So 5 cm is 5 × 2, which is 10 km.

questions.subject: hass
questions.prompt: Ava wants to see the dates of past events in the right order. Which kind of source shows this best?
questions.explanation: A timeline puts dates and events in order, from earliest to latest.

questions.subject: hass
questions.prompt: A council wants a new road through bushland. A bushwalker says it will harm koalas. A truck driver says it will save time. Why do they disagree?
choices: One of them is telling lies
Only one of them lives nearby
questions.explanation: People have different perspectives. The bushwalker cares about animals and the driver cares about travel time.

questions.subject: hass
questions.prompt: An opinion is what someone thinks or feels. A fact can be checked. Which sentence about the local pool is an opinion?
choices: Swimming is the best sport ever.
questions.explanation: You cannot check if a sport is the best. It is what someone thinks. The other sentences can be checked.

questions.subject: hass
questions.prompt:
Ben counted cars passing his school.
8 am: 40 cars
10 am: 5 cars
3 pm: 35 cars
5 pm: 8 cars
What can Ben conclude?
choices: Roads are busiest in the middle of the day
Roads are busiest when school starts and finishes
Fewer cars drive past in the morning
questions.explanation: The biggest counts are at 8 am and 3 pm. These are the times school starts and finishes.

questions.subject: hass
questions.prompt: Mei asked 20 children in Year 3 how they get to school. 15 walk, 3 catch a bus and 2 come by car. Which conclusion is supported by this information?
choices: Everyone in Australia walks to school
Walking is the best way to get to school
Children walk because it is fun
Most of these Year 3 children walk to school
questions.explanation: 15 out of 20 is more than half. The survey cannot tell us about all Australians or why children walk.
